# Hook: validate-product-change

Validate the product model after product files are edited, and the affected Product Change overlay before it is approved or sliced.

GitHub Copilot has no hook runtime, so this guard is documentation: run the commands
below yourself (or in CI) at the described moments.

## after-product-files-edited

```bash
prodshape validate
```

## before-change-approval-or-slicing

```bash
prodshape change validate ${change}
```

Hooks run deterministic commands only. They never approve a change, approve a slice, promote, edit product semantics, create backlog items or archive SDD work.
